notes: Finger drums! The Studio's new Pads page is a full drum-pad controller: eight velocity-sensitive pads playing your drum track's kit (through its FX and mixer), hit them by touch, with Z X C V / A S D F, or from your MIDI keys — ROLI octave mapping (eight keys from any base note) or the standard GM drum map for hardware pad controllers. Turn on Record while the loop plays and every hit quantizes onto the nearest 1/16 of your pattern. ROLI key lights: the eight pad keys stay lit on the LUMI and flash with every hit — including the loop's own beat, so your keyboard shows the groove.
